name: ansible-lens
description: Fast Ansible language server, IntelliSense, and <20ms linter for YAML & Jinja2. No Python, WSL, or Docker.

ansibleLens.lint.enabled.description: Enable static Ansible linting and workspace project integrity checks.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Syntax and module schema validation only.
Minimal checks plus security, idempotency, and undefined-variable detection (excludes role-prefix naming).
All 24 lint and project integrity rules at their default severities.
All 24 rules enabled, with all warnings elevated to errors.
ansibleLens.lint.profile.description: Lint strictness profile controlling active rules and warning severity.

ansibleLens.lint.rules.markdownDescription: Override severity for individual lint rules by rule ID (for example, `{ "var-naming[no-role-prefix]": "off", "package-latest": "error" }`).

ansibleLens.lint.extraVars.markdownDescription: Variable names passed at runtime (via `-e` / `--extra-vars` or CI) to exempt from `undefined-variable` warnings.

ansibleLens.metadata.autoDownload.markdownDescription: Automatically download unloaded collection metadata packs (such as `ansible.posix`) in the background with SHA-256 verification.

ansibleLens.metadata.manifestUrl.markdownDescription: Remote or internal mirror URL for `manifest.json` and `.json.gz` collection metadata packs.

ansibleLens.jinja.autoSpaceBraces.markdownDescription: Pad empty Jinja2 braces `{{|}}` to `{{ | }}` on Space and collapse both spaces back to `{{|}}` on Backspace.

ansibleLens.ansible.rootPaths.markdownDescription: Explicit Ansible project root directories (relative to the workspace root or absolute) for monorepos without an `ansible.cfg`.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Open rendered Markdown documentation inside VS Code.
Open the module's official `docs.ansible.com` page in your default browser.
Disable Ctrl+Click navigation on Ansible module names.
ansibleLens.docs.ctrlClickBehavior.description: Action to perform when Ctrl+Clicking (Go to Definition) on an Ansible module name.

scripts.package:vsix: npm run build && npx @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o ansible-lens-0.1.2.vsix
